ALGER — La présidente de l’Assemblée pop: ALGIERS — The President of the People's National Assembly (APN), Khalida Boufedeche, made a technical visit to the institution's Data Center on Thursday to get a firsthand look at the operation of this central infrastructure. Accompanied by specialized teams, she examined the mechanisms for data security, processing, and storage, which are essential for the smooth operation of exchanges between deputies and administrative services. This infrastructure, now at the heart of Parliament, symbolizes the APN's drive for modernization.
Lors d’une réunion ultérieure, Mme Boufe: During a subsequent meeting, Ms. Boufedeche reviewed the progress made in the digitization of legislative processes. The stated objective is to provide deputies with high-performance tools to accelerate legislative procedures and strengthen the oversight of government action. "The modernization of management and the digitization of the Assembly's work are particularly close to my heart," she stressed, emphasizing the alignment of this initiative with the vision of the President of the Republic, Abdelmadjid Tebboune, and the national "Algeria-Vision 2030" strategy.
Une transformation globale des méthodes: A global transformation of working methods
Pour la présidente de l’APN, la numérisa: For the President of the APN, digitization is not limited to the acquisition of technological equipment. It implies an overhaul of working methods, with three priorities: data reliability, system interconnection, and the simplification of procedures. "It is about making decisions on solid foundations, avoiding errors, and gaining responsiveness," she specified. The ambition is to place technology at the service of collective intelligence, while freeing up time for deputies and administrative staff.
Un état des lieux détaillé a été présent: A detailed inventory was presented, outlining current equipment, completed projects, those underway, and remaining needs, whether concerning hardware, software, or team training. Ms. Boufedeche praised the progress made in recent months and called for maintaining the momentum by adapting tools to the specific needs of each service.
Au-delà des aspects techniques, cette in: Beyond technical aspects, this initiative aims to strengthen trust between institutions and citizens. By facilitating the flow of information and simplifying administrative procedures, the APN intends to bring Algerians closer to their representatives. "Technology only makes sense if it frees up time for what is essential," she added, recalling that the ultimate goal is to better serve citizens.
